description: Ten-seed descriptive GaWF Jacobian and effective-connectivity analysis on balanced clean joint-switch CM-MNIST events.
notes: Each seed uses six clean events from every one of the 90 new digit-by-sector cells, for 540 events per seed.
The selected symmetric window is pre10 through post10 because larger candidate radii cannot retain all 90 cells.
Every retained window excludes sequence boundaries and any additional joint switch.
The scope is descriptive task-driven dynamics with no perturbation, intervention, or fixed-point search.
Completion requires ten seed artifacts, six regenerated PDFs, finite numeric outputs, and the final manifest and .complete marker.
Formal_v1 failed after 525 of 540 events because trailing frames outside the last complete 512-frame rollout were eligible; its partial output is retained.
Formal_v2 excludes the 254-frame trailing remainder and passed six local and six remote direct checks before launch.
